Der Text sollte dabei immer in drei Teile gegliedert sein.

instruction.text: Wie sollte ein Text gegliedert sein? Bringe die Abschnitte in die richtige Reihenfolge.

atoms.text: Die Einleitung (introduction) beinhaltet eine kurze Zusammenfassung des Textes oder des Themas.
Der Hauptteil (main part) ist der längste Teil des Textes. Er ist in Teilabschnitte gegliedert, die je nach Textart Fakten, Argumente oder Beispiele enthalten.
Der Schlussteil (conclusion) bildet den Abschluss des Textes und kann eine Zusammenfassung des Hauptteils oder eine persönliche Äußerung enthalten.

instruction.text: Lies dir die Textabschnitte durch und bringe sie in die richtige Reihenfolge.

finish.text: Neben der Struktur deines Textes ist es auch wichtig, dass du gut mit deinen Notizen aus der Planungsphase arbeitest. Überprüfe also, welche der gesammelten Informationen wichtig sind und baue diese in deinen Entwurf ein.

atoms.text:
Dear readers,
In today's issue, we will give you an insight into the debate of wearing school uniforms.

A big advantage would clearly be the creation of community and sense of togetherness. Moreover, wearing the same clothes might lead to reduced social segregation within our school. Sure, our clothes would all look the same, but that could prevent exclusion and bullying. Lastly, it seems that school uniforms can increase the concentration of students.

However, school uniforms would clearly restrict students in their self-expression as clothing is an important part of their identity. Not to mention the discomfort this might cause among the students. We also have to keep in mind that school uniforms can be expensive and therefore might be an additional burden.

Hopefully we were able to give you a good insight into the topic. Thank you for reading the school newspaper!

atoms.text:
Moving to Australia – a drawback or a chance?

How do you feel? Do you miss home? Are you happy about moving to Australia?
These are some of the questions I am confronted with every day not only by my classmates but also by myself.

One obvious downside is that I had to leave all my friends behind in London and I really miss them. Especially in the beginning, I felt a bit lonely.
However, Australians speak the same language, which is really a big advantage. Furthermore, all my classmates are nice and welcoming, so I have already met a lot of new people after just a few months and have made some good friends as well. I am still a bit scared by the many dangerous animals that live here and the extreme weather.
Nevertheless, the biggest highlight and advantage so far are Australia’s nature and wildlife. I am absolutely thrilled by all the animals I see every day and the incredible nature, like the ocean and the many national parks.

All in all, I can say that my last few months have been a huge adjustment, but most of all they have been exciting! So, I clearly decided for myself that moving to Australia is a chance. The biggest of my life so far.
